summary: Both halves inspected. Section126 concludes that the linear truncation subcategory is stable under loops but not suspension, preventing a literal dualization of Postnikov relationships. The right adjoint needed for the proposed opposite filtration is expressly doubted. The source has singular adjoint, parenthesized(n+1), and non mutually symmetric properties. all is a typed insertion over the hand by correction. The graphic section divider replaces an editorial prose margin note. Section127 keeps the basic simplicial category and changes the allowed components instead; the hemisphere-category glyph remains uncertain.
